mira (partnerships): Quick sync  partners asking for a single embargo carrier but want APAC later due to validation. Can we define a simple regional fallback?
cel (vendor-liaison): MI300 microcode MAY slip ~2 weeks. Vendor will confirm by EOD Fri.
ash (eng): Technical options: 1) announce H100/H200/B200 on schedule and mark MI300 as "pending validation"; 2) use compat-mode driver in APAC (10% perf hit).
dina (marketplace): Marketplace needs 14d for image verification. If MI300 pending, we can soft-list a placeholder SKU 7d prior with "coming soon" flag.
omar (solutions): For SIs: publish two perf baselines (nominal, compat-mode) and require a one-day dry run before GA.
press-ops: Messaging: use "staged availability" and list regional gating criteria. Avoid words like "delay".
mira (partnerships): Proposed dates: NA May 12, EU May 26, APAC Jun 9. If vendor confirms microcode by Fri keep this; if not, NA/EU proceed without MI300, APAC follows. Action owners: vendor ETA (cel) EOD Fri, marketplace placeholder (dina) by Mon, perf baselines (omar) by Mon, compat-mode docs (ash) by Tue.
cel (vendor-liaison): I'll push vendor and report EOD.
ash (eng): I'll finish compat-mode notes and include sample tuning snippet.
mira (partnerships): Thanks team  I'll draft partner packet and loop in legal. :white_check_mark:
